items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 53:1
items.html: For every Katnut has its own particular Gadlut: after attaining the Katnut and Gadlut of phase two, the Katnut of phase three begins, at which point that whole order that was in the Katnut of phase two begins anew, namely the first Ruach, the first intercourse, and so on until the completion of nursing, at which point it rises in MAN to the Gadlut of phase three. And after that, the Katnut of phase four begins, with all its stages, until the completion of nursing, and afterward the Gadlut of phase four. See below in Answer 142. (Item 895, entry beginning "And the reason" — see there for the whole continuation)
